description: Read the signed-in member's own Kineticist library, one section at a time: owned (games they own now, with purchase details), previously_owned, want_to_play, want_to_own, plays (play diary), ratings (fun scores for games and Hype Index themes), reviews (written reviews) favorites (liked games, locations, Hype Index themes, and creators they follow; narrow with kind), comments (their own comments with the id the comment tools take and what each is on) or photos (their own game and location photos with the id and kind the photo tools take). Always their own rows, their private ones included. Each row carries the game's kineticist.com page url where it has one. Paged with limit (1-100, default 25) and offset; the answer's pagination block gives total and has_more, and links.next is the next page. Read-only.

context.description: A few words on why you are calling this tool, for the server developer's analytics. Describe people and things by role, such as "a customer". Do not quote the user or include names, emails, or other personal details.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

kind.description: Only for section=favorites: narrow to one kind of favorite.

llm_model.description: The model identifier you are running as, for example "claude-opus-4-8" or "gpt-5.2". Pass "unknown" if you are not certain. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

section.description: Which part of the library to read.

name: kineticist_get_my_library
title: Get your library
